deterministic.name: check-test-file-references.sh
deterministic.evidence: Applied by hand; the private script was not executed. Documented rule: files referenced in both tests and solution must also be mentioned in instruction.md or task.toml. /app/app.db is referenced in tests/test.sh:98 (APP_DB="/app/app.db") and in solution/solve.sh:10 and :37 (the databaseFiles array and rm -f -- /app/app.db ...). instruction.md (5 lines) and task.toml never mention app.db; only environment/instructions/integration.md:9 does, which this common checker is not documented to read. The frozen template solve.sh is a single cp line and names no such path, so the overlap is task-added. /app/server.js is not affected (solve.sh:6 uses $source_app/server.js).
deterministic.counterexample: A path-intersection checker extracts /app/app.db from tests/test.sh and from solution/solve.sh, finds it in neither instruction.md nor task.toml, and reports a hidden file. A task with the template one-line solve.sh passes the same checker.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Either name /app/app.db in instruction.md in one natural sentence about where saved data lives, or stop spelling the literal database paths in solve.sh. Then run the real checker on the new candidate.
